verdict.rationale: The pricing page says new users get $5 of free credit with no credit card required. It also lists per-second pay-as-you-go rates with no compute minimum, and the get-started docs walk developers through installing SDKs and creating their own team-scoped API key, so they can start building without contacting sales. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that signup is fully self-serve, and documentation of free-credit limits such as expiry or usage caps.
